questions.questionText: Which statement best defines cloud computing?

options.text: On-demand delivery of computing resources over a network

questions.correctExplanation: Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of computing resources such as compute, storage, and networking over a network, typically using scalable and consumption-based services.

distractorExplanations.b: CapEx is upfront spending to acquire long-lived assets; it does not satisfy the requirement to define cloud computing.
distractorExplanations.c: Private cloud is cloud infrastructure dedicated to one organization; it does not satisfy the requirement to define cloud computing.
distractorExplanations.d: Resource locks is controls that prevent accidental deletion or modification; it does not satisfy the requirement to define cloud computing.

questions.hint: Think on-demand access to IT resources.

questions.questionText: Which cloud model provides services operated by a cloud provider and offered to multiple customers?
questions.correctExplanation: A public cloud is operated by a cloud service provider and makes cloud resources available to multiple customers over the internet.

distractorExplanations.a: Private cloud is cloud infrastructure dedicated to one organization; it does not satisfy the requirement to describe provider-operated shared cloud infrastructure.
distractorExplanations.b: Hybrid cloud is an architecture combining on-premises/private resources with public cloud; it does not satisfy the requirement to describe provider-operated shared cloud infrastructure.
distractorExplanations.c: SaaS is a finished application delivered as a service; it does not satisfy the requirement to describe provider-operated shared cloud infrastructure.

questions.questionText: An organization combines its own datacenter with Azure resources. Which cloud model is this?
questions.correctExplanation: Hybrid cloud combines on-premises or private infrastructure with public cloud services such as Azure.

distractorExplanations.a: Private cloud is cloud infrastructure dedicated to one organization; it does not satisfy the requirement to combine on-premises and public cloud resources.
distractorExplanations.b: SaaS is a finished application delivered as a service; it does not satisfy the requirement to combine on-premises and public cloud resources.
distractorExplanations.d: Public cloud is provider-operated cloud resources offered to multiple customers; it does not satisfy the requirement to combine on-premises and public cloud resources.

questions.hint: Look for two environments working together.

questions.questionText: A company requires cloud infrastructure dedicated to only its organization. Which model fits best?
questions.correctExplanation: A private cloud is dedicated to a single organization and provides greater control over its dedicated cloud environment.

distractorExplanations.a: PaaS is a managed application platform that abstracts most OS and infrastructure administration; it does not satisfy the requirement to provide dedicated cloud infrastructure.
distractorExplanations.c: Public cloud is provider-operated cloud resources offered to multiple customers; it does not satisfy the requirement to provide dedicated cloud infrastructure.
distractorExplanations.d: Hybrid cloud is an architecture combining on-premises/private resources with public cloud; it does not satisfy the requirement to provide dedicated cloud infrastructure.

questions.questionText: Which spending model is most associated with purchasing physical servers before they are used?
questions.correctExplanation: Capital expenditure is upfront spending on long-lived assets such as owned datacenter servers.

distractorExplanations.b: OpEx is ongoing operating spending for consumed services; it does not satisfy the requirement to classify upfront server purchases.
distractorExplanations.c: Elasticity is the ability to dynamically add or remove capacity as demand changes; it does not satisfy the requirement to classify upfront server purchases.
distractorExplanations.d: SaaS is a finished application delivered as a service; it does not satisfy the requirement to classify upfront server purchases.

questions.questionText: Paying monthly for Azure resources as they are consumed is primarily which type of expenditure?
questions.correctExplanation: Operational expenditure covers ongoing operating costs; consumption-based Azure charges are commonly treated as OpEx rather than upfront hardware CapEx.

distractorExplanations.a: CapEx is upfront spending to acquire long-lived assets; it does not satisfy the requirement to classify consumption-based operating spending.
distractorExplanations.b: Private cloud is cloud infrastructure dedicated to one organization; it does not satisfy the requirement to classify consumption-based operating spending.
distractorExplanations.c: Availability Zone is a physically separate datacenter location within an Azure region; it does not satisfy the requirement to classify consumption-based operating spending.

questions.questionText: Which cloud concept describes increasing or decreasing capacity to meet workload demand?

distractorExplanations.a: Predictability is improved consistency and forecasting of performance or cost; it does not satisfy the requirement to adjust resource capacity.
distractorExplanations.b: CapEx is upfront spending to acquire long-lived assets; it does not satisfy the requirement to adjust resource capacity.

questions.questionText: Which statement correctly describes the shared responsibility model in cloud computing?

options.text: Customer manages identities and data while the provider manages physical infrastructure
Provider is responsible for every aspect of customer data security
Customer is responsible for datacenter physical security
Shared responsibility is identical for IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS

questions.correctExplanation: In the shared responsibility model, the cloud provider is responsible for the physical cloud infrastructure, while customers retain responsibilities such as identities, data, access, and configurations. The exact division changes by service model.

distractorExplanations.b: Provider is responsible for every aspect of customer data security is an incorrect claim because customers retain responsibilities for data, identities, and configuration; it does not satisfy the requirement to describe shared cloud security responsibility.
distractorExplanations.c: Customer is responsible for datacenter physical security is an incorrect claim because the cloud provider secures its physical datacenters; it does not satisfy the requirement to describe shared cloud security responsibility.
distractorExplanations.d: Shared responsibility is identical for IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS is an incorrect claim because responsibility shifts as more layers are managed by the provider; it does not satisfy the requirement to describe shared cloud security responsibility.

questions.hint: Responsibility is shared and shifts by service type.

distractorExplanations.a: Azure Service Health is personalized information about Azure incidents, maintenance, and advisories; it does not satisfy the requirement to automate deployments.
distractorExplanations.b: Azure Pricing Calculator is a tool for estimating Azure solution cost before deployment; it does not satisfy the requirement to automate deployments.
distractorExplanations.c: Resource locks is controls that prevent accidental deletion or modification; it does not satisfy the requirement to automate deployments.

questions.questionText: A team needs one Azure platform to correlate infrastructure metrics, application telemetry, logs, and alerts. Which service should it use?
questions.correctExplanation: Azure Monitor provides centralized observability across infrastructure and applications by collecting and correlating metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

distractorExplanations.a: Azure Pricing Calculator is a tool for estimating Azure solution cost before deployment; it does not satisfy the requirement to centralize monitoring telemetry.
distractorExplanations.b: Azure Data Box is a physical appliance-based service for large offline data transfers; it does not satisfy the requirement to centralize monitoring telemetry.
distractorExplanations.c: Microsoft Purview is data governance, discovery, protection, and compliance capabilities; it does not satisfy the requirement to centralize monitoring telemetry.
